headline: A federal law renames a Postal Service facility in Canyon, Texas, after Gary James Fletcher.
what_it_does: This act names the United States Postal Service building at 1304 4th Avenue in Canyon, Texas, the Gary James Fletcher Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or anything else about how the office operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 2, 2022.
